_readme: Optional: an operator's read-only export from production. The runner never reads production itself. Without it, C compares against its own control arm, and nonzero output-gate refusals are UNDETERMINED. firstAttemptScores are each ordinary render's FIRST attempt score: generations.pipeline_log's last entry, identityAttempts[0].score, for these characters' succeeded image renders on this engine. Not match_score: since the identity gate went on, match_score holds the delivered attempt's score, the better of two whenever the gate re-rendered, while the set shots are scored on their first attempt only.
